card.name: Word-start L before names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized name beginning with L, such as the ERO in LEROCHOL, Len in Lennox-Gastaut or lenalidomide, or Ler in Lerwick. It fires when the name is still unfinished.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word-continuation pieces and away from unrelated tokens, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It marks the start of a name beginning with L, like Lennox-Gastaut or a brand name, when more letters are still to come.
